notes.note: Reviewed the startup claims in theming against the painter and display-preferences/startup-theme entry points. Both saved Station Reduced and OS reduced motion now paint the completed static lockup; normal geometry and visible-time animation remain unchanged. The reduced painter continues scheduling until its first eligible admitted paint, then stops, and attribute/resize/visibility listeners retain remeasurement. Owner browser tests demonstrate the initial/live preference and covered-admission regressions before/after; four reviewed light/dark 390/1440 PNGs show the static lockup. Browser adapter fixtures do not establish physical-device or actual native-shell timing. Theming prose remains accurate; shell distribution branding/theme claims are unaffected by these startup-only changes.

Reviewed theming startup readiness/handoff and telemetry prompt initial-focus claims through commitInitialStartup, pending retains, reconsider, finish and UsageSharingPrompt afterInitialStartup registration. Station Reduced now skips the intro/fade after readiness just as OS reduce does; pending waits still block release. Finish restores root access, removes observers and then invokes retained focus listeners; unmount cancels the prompt focus callback. Normal visible intro timing and immediate recovery remain unchanged. Fourteen owner browser cases pass, including live/initial Reduced and native-admission adapter coverage; no physical/native-shell execution claim. Theming and the cited telemetry focus explanation remain accurate; transitive shell branding claims do not depend on the changed motion decision.
